pnlSchedule: Airport Schedule: every flight of your save leaving your field, by departure time, yours underlined. For a steerpoint (a tap on a flight-plan row): what the mission says of it, and where it is.
btnSaveJpg: Saves the schedule as a picture (<field>Schedule.jpg) on the BMS PC, in DataCards\<mission>\<package>\<callsign>, after asking the mission name and package number.
